package gateways

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"example.test/gwapp/internal/domain"
	models "example.test/gwapp/internal/models/gateways"
	rules "example.test/gwapp/internal/rules/gateways"
	"example.test/gwapp/internal/scope"
)

// Rename changes a gateway's name of the verified tenant.
func Rename(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	ports RenamePorts,
	in models.RenameGateway,
) (models.GatewayInfo, error) {
	if !rules.ValidName(in.Name) || in.ID == "" {
		return models.GatewayInfo{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: name", domain.ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	return ports.Registry.Rename(ctx, e, in)
}
